description: Every 15 minutes, finds appointment slots that have come free in Cliniko over the next 7 days (starting at least 2 hours from now): bookings that were cancelled, plus old times freed when "Apply patient's chosen reschedule time" moved a booking. Skips any slot someone has since been booked into. For each free slot it lists patients who could take it (those booked later with the same practitioner, and overdue patients last seen 6–16 weeks ago with nothing booked) and creates one WorkQ item. It never contacts a patient or changes a booking.

flowIr.description: Polls Cliniko for freed slots (no booking-cancelled trigger exists), keeps those 2 hours to 7 days out that are still free, builds a candidate list per slot, and raises one WorkQ item each. First step of the cancellation gap filler; offers are not sent yet.
flowIr.name: Cliniko Automations: Find freed slots to fill

nodes.code:
import json

slug = params["slug"]
handled = params.get("handled_slot_keys") or []

api.files.put(
    file="PracticeManager/State/" + slug + "-gap-filler.json",
    content=json.dumps({"handled_slot_keys": handled}, indent=2),
    scope="org",
)
